verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs say it calculates and files taxes automatically and handles all associated federal, state, and local filings, which plausibly covers year-end W-2 filing. A community report also confirms Gusto produces W-2 forms, though it describes an erroneous W-2c reissue. Neither source names W-2 or 1099 generation explicitly. missing for 10: explicit documentation of W-2 generation, any evidence of 1099 generation for contractors, documented automatic distribution of forms to workers, a year-end-specific workflow, and independent corroboration that it works reliably.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have W-2s and 1099s generated and distributed to workers automatically at year-end

citations.quote: all associated federal, state, and local filings and payments
